name: Grid-connected electricity generation from renewable sources
description: Large-scale CDM methodology for new, capacity-addition or retrofit renewable power (solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, etc.) displacing grid electricity.
formula: ER_y = BE_y − PE_y;  BE_y = EG_PJ,y × EF_grid,CM,y;  PE_y = PE_FF,y + PE_GP,y + PE_HP,y  (EG_PJ,y = EG_facility,y for greenfield; net of baseline generation for retrofits/additions)
